svg.text: MOTTO · how it goes together
Exploded side view (from the right) at the spine, front at the left · 1 mm = 6.6 px
Same core as SLAB (keys, strip C, D and battery under the keys; A over B under the panel). What's new is
the curved board edge, the rose, the hinge and stay, and the lid that comes off whole for painting.
Numbers = build steps (15 in total).
Checked against eng v2 §4.1, §4.2 · answers E8 · budget-variant §v1.4b rev 6 · common-how-it-works §1, §5, §6
Lid: 3 mm walnut skin (outside only) · 12 mm laser frame · raw birch face
the inner face is the canvas; the frame clears the knobs
Brass piano hinge (110 mm, straight tail) + captive folding stay
stay detent at 100°; no half-open detent (can't fall on a hand)
Knobs: bought skirted caps; the chartreuse hero is one bought cap
painted or ordered in colour
Panel sandwich: A over B cut to the curve (Edge.Cuts arc)
rose grille over the Ø40 driver at the rear-left; 12 pip LEDs (11 on A + mod)
Body: ≈ 10 curved laser layers, cork-faced
jacks follow board A's curved back edge
Keys: walnut lever tops, owner-cut at Vector Space; bone acrylic sharps
on Choc V2 silent, magnet in the top over a TO-92 SS49E: reverse colours
Strip C = switch board: 25 Choc V2 + 25 standing SS49E
#2765 stick + mod slide pot sit at the left (22 mm zone)
Board D + 2 LiPo pouch cells under the keys
away from the VCOs
Base plate, screws; felt feet
the outline follows the bentside
← player (front)
mm
